18:  * Полноэкранный оверлей поверх любого приложения/сайта: затемнение вне рамки,
19:  * рамка выбора области, тулбар с кнопками и нижняя панель распознанного текста.
20:  *
21:  * Вся графика рисуется на Canvas (без внешних UI-библиотек), тач-обработка —
22:  * на MotionEvent. Кнопки срабатывают по ACTION_UP, рамка перетаскивается и
23:  * масштабируется за углы/грани.
24:  */
25: class OverlayView(
26:     context: Context,
27:     private val callback: Callback,
28: ) : View(context) {
29: 
30:     interface Callback {
31:         fun onScan()
32:         fun onSpeak()
33:         fun onCycleVoice()
34:         fun onOpacity(delta: Float)
35:         fun onPassThrough()
36:         fun onResetFrame()
37:         fun onExit()
38:         fun onFrameChanged(f: RectFBean)
39:     }
40: 
41:     enum class Btn(val label: String) {
42:         SCAN("Скан"),
43:         SPEAK("Читать"),
44:         VOICE("Голос"),
45:         OPAQUE("Прозр"),
46:         HIDE("Скрыть"),
47:         EXIT("Выход"),
48:     }
49: 
50:     private enum class Mode { NONE, MOVE, H_RESIZE, V_RESIZE, CORNER_RESIZE, SCROLL }
51: 
52:     // Публичное состояние, управляется сервисом.
53:     var scanning: Boolean = false
54:     var statusText: String = ""
55: 
56:     /**
57:      * Распознанный текст. Панель результата держится высотой в одну строку статуса,
58:      * пока текста нет, и разворачивается на полную высоту вместе с текстом — при
59:      * запуске оверлей не занимает низ экрана впустую.
60:      */
61:     var resultText: String = ""
62:         set(value) {
63:             if (field == value) return
64:             field = value
65:             scrollLines = 0
66:             scrollAccum = 0f
67:             layoutPanel()
68:             clampFrame()
69:             invalidate()
70:         }
71: 
72:     // «Прокачка» кадров на время захвата: оверлей постоянно перерисовывается,
73:     // поэтому дисплей (а с ним и VirtualDisplay) получает свежие кадры даже на
74:     // полностью статичном экране. Сама графика при этом рисуется как обычно:
75:     // область захвата лежит между панелями, поэтому в кадр они не попадают.
76:     private var capturePumping = false
77:     private val pumpHandler = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())
78:     private val pumpRunnable = object : Runnable {
79:         override fun run() {
80:             if (capturePumping) {
81:                 invalidate()
82:                 pumpHandler.postDelayed(this, 90)
83:             }
84:         }
85:     }
86: 
87:     fun beginCapturePump() {
88:         if (capturePumping) return
89:         capturePumping = true
90:         pumpHandler.post(pumpRunnable)
91:     }
92: 
93:     fun endCapturePump() {
94:         capturePumping = false
95:         pumpHandler.removeCallbacks(pumpRunnable)
96:         invalidate()
97:     }
98: 
99:     private lateinit var frame: RectF
100:     private var toolbarRect = RectF()
101:     private var panelRect = RectF()
102:     private val buttons = ArrayList<Pair<RectF, Btn>>()
103: 
104:     private var mode = Mode.NONE
105:     private var pressedBtn: Btn? = null
106:     private var touchX = 0f
107:     private var touchY = 0f
108:     private var startFrame = RectF()
109:     private var scrollLines = 0
110:     private var scrollAccum = 0f
111:     private var lastPanelY = 0f
112:     private var contentLines: List<String> = emptyList()
113:     private var visibleLines = 1
114: 
115:     private val path = Path()
116: 
117:     private val dimPaint = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG)
118:     private val borderPaint = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
119:         style = Paint.Style.STROKE
120:         strokeWidth = dp(2f)
121:         color = Color.parseColor("#4FC3F7")
122:     }
123:     private val handlePaint = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
124:         style = Paint.Style.FILL
125:         color = Color.parseColor("#4FC3F7")
126:     }
127:     private val panelPaint = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
128:         color = Color.parseColor("#E6121420")
129:     }
130:     private val toolbarPaint = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
131:         color = Color.parseColor("#F0141A2E")
132:     }
133:     private val btnPaint = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
134:         textSize = sp(12f)
135:         typeface = Typeface.DEFAULT
136:     }
137:     private val titlePaint = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
138:         color = Color.WHITE
139:         textSize = sp(14f)
140:         typeface = Typeface.DEFAULT_BOLD
141:     }
142:     private val statusPaint = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
143:         color = Color.parseColor("#90CAF9")
144:         textSize = sp(11f)
145:     }
146:     private val resultPaint = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
147:         color = Color.WHITE
148:         textSize = sp(13f)
149:         typeface = Typeface.SANS_SERIF
150:     }
151: 
152:     private val density: Float = resources.displayMetrics.density
153: 
154:     private fun dp(v: Float): Float = v * density
155: 
156:     private fun sp(v: Float): Float = v * resources.displayMetrics.scaledDensity
157: 
158:     override fun onSizeChanged(w: Int, h: Int, oldw: Int, oldh: Int) {
159:         super.onSizeChanged(w, h, oldw, oldh)
160:         layoutMetrics(w.toFloat(), h.toFloat())
161:     }
162: 
163:     private var viewH = 0f
164:     private var viewW = 0f
165: 
166:     private fun layoutMetrics(w: Float, h: Float) {
167:         viewW = w
168:         viewH = h
169:         // Высоты панелей ограничены долей экрана: на плотных экранах (density 3+)
170:         // фиксированные dp съедали бы заметную часть дисплея.
171:         val toolbarH = min(dp(44f), h * 0.07f)
172:         toolbarRect = RectF(0f, 0f, w, toolbarH)
173:         layoutPanel()
174: 
175:         val pref = Prefs.frame()
176:         frame = RectF(
177:             pref.left * w,
178:             pref.top * h,
179:             pref.right * w,
180:             pref.bottom * h,
181:         )
182:         clampFrame()
183: 
184:         buttons.clear()
185:         val count = Btn.entries.size
186:         val bw = w / count
187:         for (i in Btn.entries.indices) {
188:             buttons += Pair(
189:                 RectF(i * bw, 0f, (i + 1) * bw, toolbarH),
190:                 Btn.entries[i],
191:             )
192:         }
193:     }
194: 
195:     /** Нижняя панель: строка статуса без результата, полная высота с текстом. */
196:     private fun layoutPanel() {
197:         if (viewH <= 0f) return
198:         val collapsed = min(statusPaint.textSize * 2.2f, viewH * 0.09f)
199:         val expanded = min(dp(132f), viewH * 0.30f)
200:         val h = if (resultText.isBlank()) collapsed else max(collapsed, expanded)
201:         panelRect = RectF(0f, viewH - h, viewW, viewH)
202:     }
203: 
204:     private fun clampFrame() {
205:         if (viewW <= 0f || viewH <= 0f) return
206:         val padL = min(dp(6f), viewW * 0.02f)
207:         val padT = min(dp(6f), viewH * 0.01f)
208:         val boxTop = toolbarRect.bottom + padT
209:         val boxBottom = panelRect.top - padT
210:         val boxRight = viewW - padL
211:         // Минимальная сторона не должна превышать половину доступной высоты,
212:         // иначе на низких экранах рамка вылезала бы под панели.
213:         val minSide = max(dp(20f), min(dp(48f), (boxBottom - boxTop) * 0.5f))
214: 
215:         val left = frame.left.coerceIn(padL, max(padL, boxRight - minSide))
216:         val top = frame.top.coerceIn(boxTop, max(boxTop, boxBottom - minSide))
217:         val right = frame.right.coerceIn(left + minSide, max(left + minSide, boxRight))
218:         val bottom = frame.bottom.coerceIn(top + minSide, max(top + minSide, boxBottom))
219:         frame.set(left, top, right, bottom)
220:     }
221: 
222:     override fun onDraw(canvas: Canvas) {
223:         super.onDraw(canvas)
224: 
225:         val alpha = (Prefs.overlayOpacity().coerceIn(0.1f, 0.9f) * 255).toInt()
226:         dimPaint.color = Color.argb(alpha, 4, 8, 20)
227: 
228:         // Затемнение вокруг рамки. Четыре прямоугольника идут строго встык, иначе
229:         // наложение давало бы участки, затемнённые вдвое.
230:         canvas.drawRect(0f, 0f, viewW, toolbarRect.bottom, dimPaint)
231:         canvas.drawRect(0f, toolbarRect.bottom, frame.left, frame.top, dimPaint)
232:         canvas.drawRect(frame.right, toolbarRect.bottom, viewW, frame.top, dimPaint)
233:         canvas.drawRect(0f, frame.top, frame.left, frame.bottom, dimPaint)
234:         canvas.drawRect(frame.right, frame.top, viewW, frame.bottom, dimPaint)
235:         canvas.drawRect(0f, frame.bottom, viewW, viewH, dimPaint)
236: 
237:         // Рамка захвата.
238:         canvas.drawRoundRect(frame, dp(10f), dp(10f), borderPaint)
239:         drawHandles(canvas)
240: 
241:         // Тулбар и панель результата.
242:         roundRectPath(toolbarRect, 0f, 0f, dp(10f), dp(10f))
243:         canvas.drawPath(path, toolbarPaint)
244:         drawToolbarButtons(canvas)
245: 
246:         roundRectPath(panelRect, dp(10f), dp(10f), 0f, 0f)
247:         canvas.drawPath(path, panelPaint)
248:         drawResultPanel(canvas)
249:     }
250: 
251:     /** Прямоугольник с независимым радиусом каждого угла (в dp-радиусах — px). */
252:     private fun roundRectPath(rect: RectF, tl: Float, tr: Float, br: Float, bl: Float) {
253:         path.reset()
254:         path.moveTo(rect.left + tl, rect.top)
255:         path.lineTo(rect.right - tr, rect.top)
256:         path.quadTo(rect.right, rect.top, rect.right, rect.top + tr)
257:         path.lineTo(rect.right, rect.bottom - br)
258:         path.quadTo(rect.right, rect.bottom, rect.right - br, rect.bottom)
259:         path.lineTo(rect.left + bl, rect.bottom)
260:         path.quadTo(rect.left, rect.bottom, rect.left, rect.bottom - bl)
261:         path.lineTo(rect.left, rect.top + tl)
262:         path.quadTo(rect.left, rect.top, rect.left + tl, rect.top)
263:         path.close()
264:     }
265: 
266:     private fun drawToolbarButtons(canvas: Canvas) {
267:         for ((rect, btn) in buttons) {
268:             btnPaint.color = if (btn == pressedBtn) Color.parseColor("#FF8A65") else Color.WHITE
269:             btnPaint.textAlign = Paint.Align.CENTER
270:             canvas.drawText(btn.label, rect.centerX(), rect.centerY() + dp(4f), btnPaint)
271:         }
272:     }
273: 
274:     private fun drawHandles(canvas: Canvas) {
275:         val hs = dp(16f)
276:         val half = hs / 2
277:         for ((cx, cy) in handlePositions()) {
278:             canvas.drawRect(RectF(cx - half, cy - half, cx + half, cy + half), handlePaint)
279:         }
280:     }
281: 
282:     private fun handlePositions(): List<Pair<Float, Float>> {
283:         val midX = (frame.left + frame.right) / 2
284:         val midY = (frame.top + frame.bottom) / 2
285:         return listOf(
286:             frame.left to frame.top,
287:             midX to frame.top,
288:             frame.right to frame.top,
289:             frame.left to midY,
290:             frame.right to midY,
291:             frame.left to frame.bottom,
292:             midX to frame.bottom,
293:             frame.right to frame.bottom,
294:         )
295:     }
296: 
297:     private fun drawResultPanel(canvas: Canvas) {
298:         val pad = dp(10f)
299:         statusPaint.textAlign = Paint.Align.LEFT
300:         val status = if (scanning) "Распознаю текст…" else statusText.ifBlank { "Готово" }
301:         val textMetrics = statusPaint.fontMetrics
302:         val statusBaseline = if (resultText.isBlank()) {
303:             // Свёрнутая панель — одна строка по центру.
304:             panelRect.centerY() - (textMetrics.ascent + textMetrics.descent) / 2f
305:         } else {
306:             panelRect.top + dp(20f)
307:         }
308:         canvas.drawText(status, pad, statusBaseline, statusPaint)
309: 
310:         contentLines = emptyList()
311:         visibleLines = 0
312:         val text = resultText
313:         if (text.isNotBlank()) {
314:             val maxW = (panelRect.width() - pad * 2).toInt()
315:             val lines = wrapText(resultPaint, text, maxW)
316:             val lineH = resultPaint.textSize * 1.25f
317:             val available = panelRect.height() - dp(34f)
318:             val visible = (available / lineH).toInt().coerceAtLeast(1)
319:             contentLines = lines
320:             visibleLines = visible
321:             scrollLines = scrollLines.coerceIn(0, max(0, lines.size - visible))
322:             var y = panelRect.top + dp(34f) + lineH
323:             for (i in scrollLines until min(scrollLines + visible, lines.size)) {
324:                 canvas.drawText(lines[i], pad, y, resultPaint)
325:                 y += lineH
326:             }
327:         }
328:     }
329: 
330:     private fun maxScroll(): Int = max(0, contentLines.size - visibleLines)
331: 
332:     private fun wrapText(paint: Paint, text: String, maxW: Int): List<String> {
333:         val words = text.split(" ")
334:         val lines = ArrayList<String>()
335:         var line = StringBuilder()
336:         for (word in words) {
337:             val probe = if (line.isEmpty()) word else "$line $word"
338:             if (paint.measureText(probe) <= maxW) {
339:                 line = StringBuilder(probe)
340:             } else {
341:                 if (line.isNotEmpty()) lines += line.toString()
342:                 line = StringBuilder(word)
343:                 while (line.isNotEmpty() && paint.measureText(line.toString()) > maxW) {
344:                     var cut = line.length
345:                     while (cut > 1 && paint.measureText(line.substring(0, cut)) > maxW) cut--
346:                     lines += line.substring(0, cut)
347:                     line = StringBuilder(line.substring(cut))
348:                 }
349:             }
350:         }
351:         if (line.isNotEmpty()) lines += line.toString()
352:         return lines
353:     }
354: 
355:     override fun onTouchEvent(event: MotionEvent): Boolean {
356:         val x = event.x
357:         val y = event.y
358:         when (event.actionMasked) {
359:             MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN -> return onDown(x, y)
360:             MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE -> { onMove(x, y); return true }
361:             MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL -> {
362:                 onUp()
363:                 return true
364:             }
365:         }
366:         return true
367:     }
368: 
369:     private fun onDown(x: Float, y: Float): Boolean {
370:         touchX = x
371:         touchY = y
372:         startFrame.set(frame)
373:         lastPanelY = y
374: 
375:         for ((rect, btn) in buttons) {
376:             if (rect.contains(x, y)) {
377:                 pressedBtn = btn
378:                 invalidate()
379:                 return true
380:             }
381:         }
382:         if (panelRect.contains(x, y) && resultText.isNotBlank()) {
383:             mode = Mode.SCROLL
384:             return true
385:         }
386:         val handle = findHandle(x, y)
387:         if (handle != null) {
388:             mode = Mode.CORNER_RESIZE
389:             handleIndex = handle
390:             return true
391:         }
392:         if (frame.contains(x, y)) {
393:             mode = Mode.MOVE
394:             return true
395:         }
396:         return true
397:     }
398: 
399:     private var handleIndex = -1
400: 
401:     private fun findHandle(x: Float, y: Float): Int? {
402:         val r = dp(20f)
403:         for ((i, pos) in handlePositions().withIndex()) {
404:             if (Math.abs(x - pos.first) <= r && Math.abs(y - pos.second) <= r) return i
405:         }
406:         return null
407:     }
408: 
409:     private fun onMove(x: Float, y: Float) {
410:         val dx = x - touchX
411:         val dy = y - touchY
412:         when (mode) {
413:             Mode.MOVE -> {
414:                 val fw = startFrame.width()
415:                 val fh = startFrame.height()
416:                 val pad = dp(6f)
417:                 // Сдвиг ограничиваем по обеим осям сразу: иначе рамка не доезжала
418:                 // до левого/верхнего края, зато уезжала за правый/нижний.
419:                 val maxLeft = viewW - pad - fw
420:                 val newLeft = (startFrame.left + dx).coerceIn(min(pad, maxLeft), max(pad, maxLeft))
421:                 val minTop = toolbarRect.bottom + pad
422:                 val maxTop = panelRect.top - pad - fh
423:                 val newTop = (startFrame.top + dy).coerceIn(min(minTop, maxTop), max(minTop, maxTop))
424:                 frame.set(newLeft, newTop, newLeft + fw, newTop + fh)
425:                 clampFrame()
426:                 invalidate()
427:             }
428:             Mode.CORNER_RESIZE -> {
429:                 resizeTo(dx, dy)
430:                 invalidate()
431:             }
432:             Mode.SCROLL -> {
433:                 val lineH = resultPaint.textSize * 1.25f
434:                 // Дробный остаток копится: иначе медленное перетаскивание
435:                 // (меньше строки за кадр) не листало текст вовсе.
436:                 scrollAccum += (y - lastPanelY) / lineH
437:                 val whole = scrollAccum.toInt()
438:                 if (whole != 0) {
439:                     scrollAccum -= whole
440:                     val next = (scrollLines + whole).coerceIn(0, maxScroll())
441:                     if (next == scrollLines) scrollAccum = 0f
442:                     scrollLines = next
443:                 }
444:                 lastPanelY = y
445:                 invalidate()
446:             }
447:             else -> Unit
448:         }
449:         touchX = x
450:         touchY = y
451:     }
452: 
453:     private fun resizeTo(dx: Float, dy: Float) {
454:         val minSide = min(dp(48f), max(dp(20f), (panelRect.top - toolbarRect.bottom) * 0.5f))
455:         val l = frame.left
456:         val t = frame.top
457:         val r = frame.right
458:         val b = frame.bottom
459:         when (handleIndex) {
460:             0 -> { val nl = (startFrame.left + dx).coerceAtMost(r - minSide); frame.set(nl, (startFrame.top + dy).coerceAtMost(b - minSide), r, b) }
461:             1 -> frame.set(l, (startFrame.top + dy).coerceAtMost(b - minSide), r, b)
462:             2 -> { val nr = (startFrame.right + dx).coerceAtLeast(l + minSide); frame.set(l, (startFrame.top + dy).coerceAtMost(b - minSide), nr, b) }
463:             3 -> { val nl = (startFrame.left + dx).coerceAtMost(r - minSide); frame.set(nl, t, r, b) }
464:             4 -> { val nr = (startFrame.right + dx).coerceAtLeast(l + minSide); frame.set(l, t, nr, b) }
465:             5 -> { val nl = (startFrame.left + dx).coerceAtMost(r - minSide); val nb = (startFrame.bottom + dy).coerceAtLeast(t + minSide); frame.set(nl, t, r, nb) }
466:             6 -> frame.set(l, t, r, (startFrame.bottom + dy).coerceAtLeast(t + minSide))
467:             7 -> { val nb = (startFrame.bottom + dy).coerceAtLeast(t + minSide); frame.set(l, t, (startFrame.right + dx).coerceAtLeast(l + minSide), nb) }
468:         }
469:         clampFrame()
470:     }
471: 
472:     private fun onUp() {
473:         val btn = pressedBtn
474:         pressedBtn = null
475:         mode = Mode.NONE
476:         // Рамку сохраняем до действия: «Скан» читает Prefs.frame(), и при
477:         // прежнем порядке захватывалась старая область, если рамку только что
478:         // передвинули.
479:         callback.onFrameChanged(bean())
480:         if (btn != null) perform(btn)
481:         invalidate()
482:     }
483: 
484:     private fun perform(btn: Btn) {
485:         when (btn) {
486:             Btn.SCAN -> callback.onScan()
487:             Btn.SPEAK -> callback.onSpeak()
488:             Btn.VOICE -> callback.onCycleVoice()
489:             Btn.OPAQUE -> callback.onOpacity(0.08f)
490:             Btn.HIDE -> callback.onPassThrough()
491:             Btn.EXIT -> callback.onExit()
492:         }
493:     }
494: 
495:     private fun bean(): RectFBean = RectFBean(
496:         left = (frame.left / viewW).coerceIn(0f, 1f),
497:         top = (frame.top / viewH).coerceIn(0f, 1f),
498:         right = (frame.right / viewW).coerceIn(0f, 1f),
499:         bottom = (frame.bottom / viewH).coerceIn(0f, 1f),
500:     )
501: 
502:     fun resetFrame() {
503:         val boxTop = toolbarRect.bottom + dp(10f)
504:         val boxBottom = panelRect.top - dp(10f)
505:         val boxH = max(dp(48f), boxBottom - boxTop)
506:         val left = min(viewW * 0.06f, viewW - dp(6f))
507:         // Высота рамки считалась от viewW, а не от viewH, — в альбомной
508:         // ориентации уезжала далеко за нижнюю панель.
509:         val top = min(boxTop + boxH * 0.1f, boxBottom)
510:         val right = max(min(viewW * 0.94f, viewW - dp(6f)), left)
511:         val bottom = max(min(top + boxH * 0.55f, boxBottom), top)
512:         frame.set(left, top, right, bottom)
513:         clampFrame()
514:         invalidate()
515:     }
516: }

data class OcrResultPopupSettings(
    val widthDp: Int,
    val heightDp: Int,
    val contentScale: Float,
)

@Composable
fun OcrResultOverlay(
    onDismissRequest: () -> Unit,
    presentation: OcrResultPresentation,
    popupSettings: OcrResultPopupSettings,
    dimBackground: Boolean,
    queryText: String,
    initialSearchText: String = queryText,
    /**
     * Кто распознал: при ручном выборе областей качество сильно зависит от
     * движка, и без подписи непонятно, почему один и тот же фрагмент читается
     * то лучше, то хуже. null — источник неизвестен, подписи нет.
     */
    source: OcrTextSource? = null,
    anchorRect: RectF?,
    onCopyText: () -> Unit,
    searchState: DictionarySearchScreenModel.State,
    onQueryChange: (String) -> Unit,
    onSearch: (String) -> Unit,
    onTermGroupClick: (List<DictionaryTerm>) -> Unit,
    onPlayAudioClick: (List<DictionaryTerm>) -> Unit,
    onSpeak: () -> Unit = {},
    onChooseVoice: () -> Unit = {},
    onSpeakRole: (String) -> Unit = {},
    onAddToDictionary: () -> Unit = {},
    /**
     * Убрать распознанный текст со страницы, не закрывая карточку. Раньше
     * оверлей нельзя было убрать, не закрыв результат, — а на светлой
     * странице он всё равно мешал.
     */
    onHidePageOverlay: (() -> Unit)? = null,
) {
    BackHandler(onBack = onDismissRequest)
    // Словарей нет — не дёргаем поиск и не показываем «No Dictionaries
    // Enabled»: пользователю нужен сам распознанный текст.
    val noDictionaries = searchState.dictionaries.isEmpty()
    LaunchedEffect(queryText, initialSearchText, noDictionaries) {
        if (queryText.isNotBlank() && !noDictionaries) {
            onQueryChange(queryText)
            onSearch(initialSearchText)
        }
    }

    when {
        noDictionaries -> {
            OcrPlainTextCard(
                text = queryText,
                source = source,
                dimBackground = dimBackground,
                onDismissRequest = onDismissRequest,
                onCopyText = onCopyText,
                onSpeak = onSpeak,
                onChooseVoice = onChooseVoice,
                onSpeakRole = onSpeakRole,
                onAddToDictionary = onAddToDictionary,
                onHidePageOverlay = onHidePageOverlay,
            )
        }
        presentation == OcrResultPresentation.POPUP && anchorRect != null -> {
            OcrResultPopup(
                onDismissRequest = onDismissRequest,
                anchorRect = anchorRect,
                settings = popupSettings,
                onCopyText = onCopyText,
                searchState = searchState,
                onQueryChange = onQueryChange,
                onSearch = onSearch,
                onTermGroupClick = onTermGroupClick,
                onPlayAudioClick = onPlayAudioClick,
                onSpeak = onSpeak,
                onChooseVoice = onChooseVoice,
                onSpeakRole = onSpeakRole,
                onAddToDictionary = onAddToDictionary,
                onHidePageOverlay = onHidePageOverlay,
            )
        }
        else -> {
            OcrResultBottomSheet(
                onDismissRequest = onDismissRequest,
                onCopyText = onCopyText,
                searchState = searchState,
                onQueryChange = onQueryChange,
                onSearch = onSearch,
                onTermGroupClick = onTermGroupClick,
                onPlayAudioClick = onPlayAudioClick,
                actions = {
                    OcrResultActionBar(
                        onSpeak = onSpeak,
                        onCopyText = onCopyText,
                        onChooseVoice = onChooseVoice,
                        onSpeakRole = onSpeakRole,
                        onAddToDictionary = onAddToDictionary,
                        onHidePageOverlay = onHidePageOverlay,
                    )
                },
            )
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Затемнение, тап по которому закрывает результат.
 *
 * Раньше блок был написан, но завёрнут в `if (false)`: карточка висела
 * поверх страницы, и закрыть её можно было только кнопкой в самой карточке
 * или аппаратной «назад». Теперь тап мимо карточки и по затемнению гасит
 * результат — то самое, чего не хватало.
 */
@Composable
private fun OcrDismissScrim(
    dim: Boolean,
    onDismissRequest: () -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
) {
    Box(
        modifier = modifier
            .fillMaxSize()
            .then(
                if (dim) {
                    Modifier.background(MaterialTheme.colorScheme.scrim.copy(alpha = 0.32f))
                } else {
                    Modifier
                },
            )
            .clickable(
                indication = null,
                interactionSource = remember { MutableInteractionSource() },
                onClick = onDismissRequest,
            ),
    )
}

/**
 * Карточка распознанного текста без словарной части: текст можно скопировать
 * и озвучить, лишних сообщений «словари не найдены» нет.
 *
 * Карточка намеренно небольшая: текст ограничен по высоте и прокручивается
 * внутри, а действия собраны в одну строку иконок под ним. Раньше здесь были
 * два ряда подписей и отдельные плавающие кнопки — вместе они закрывали
 * половину экрана.
 */
@Composable
private fun OcrPlainTextCard(
    text: String,
    source: OcrTextSource?,
    dimBackground: Boolean,
    onDismissRequest: () -> Unit,
    onCopyText: () -> Unit,
    onSpeak: () -> Unit = {},
    onChooseVoice: () -> Unit = {},
    onSpeakRole: (String) -> Unit = {},
    onAddToDictionary: () -> Unit = {},
    onHidePageOverlay: (() -> Unit)? = null,
) {
    BoxWithConstraints(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
        // Не больше трети экрана: карточка не должна закрывать рисунок.
        val maxTextHeight = (maxHeight * 0.3f).coerceAtLeast(96.dp)

        OcrDismissScrim(dim = dimBackground, onDismissRequest = onDismissRequest)

        Surface(
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp),
            color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surfaceContainerHigh,
            tonalElevation = 6.dp,
            modifier = Modifier
                .align(Alignment.BottomCenter)
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .padding(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 24.dp)
                // Гасим тап мимо текста, иначе тап по пустому месту карточки
                // закрывал бы результат вместо выделения текста.
                .clickable(
                    indication = null,
                    interactionSource = remember { MutableInteractionSource() },
                    onClick = {},
                ),
        ) {
            Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(start = 16.dp, end = 8.dp, top = 8.dp, bottom = 8.dp)) {
                Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                    Box(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                        OcrEngineCaption(source)
                    }
                    IconButton(onClick = onDismissRequest) {
                        Icon(Icons.Outlined.Close, contentDescription = "Закрыть")
                    }
                }

                Text(
                    text = text,
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
                    color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurface,
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxWidth()
                        .heightIn(max = maxTextHeight)
                        .verticalScroll(rememberScrollState())
                        .padding(end = 8.dp),
                )

                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(4.dp))
                HorizontalDivider()
                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(4.dp))

                OcrResultActionBar(
                    onSpeak = onSpeak,
                    onCopyText = onCopyText,
                    onChooseVoice = onChooseVoice,
                    onSpeakRole = onSpeakRole,
                    onAddToDictionary = onAddToDictionary,
                    onHidePageOverlay = onHidePageOverlay,
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Подпись «кто распознал» над распознанным текстом.
 *
 * Если текст прочитал не тот движок, который выбран в настройках (без сети
 * онлайн пропускается и читает локальный), это сказано прямо: иначе
 * читатель сравнивает качество двух разных движков и делает вывод, что они
 * одинаковые.
 */
@Composable
private fun OcrEngineCaption(source: OcrTextSource?) {
    if (source == null) return
    val engineName = stringResource(source.engine.titleRes)
    val text = if (source.usedInsteadOfSelected) {
        val selectedName = stringResource(selectedOcrModel().titleRes)
        stringResource(MR.strings.ocr_recognized_by_fallback, engineName, selectedName)
    } else {
        stringResource(MR.strings.ocr_recognized_by, engineName)
    }
    Text(
        text = text,
        style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall,
        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
    )
}

255: internal fun calculatePopupPlacement(
256:     anchorRect: RectF,
257:     preferredPopupWidthPx: Float,
258:     preferredPopupHeightPx: Float,
259:     viewportWidthPx: Float,
260:     viewportHeightPx: Float,
261:     gapPx: Float,
262:     marginPx: Float,
263: ): PopupPlacement? {
264:     val viewport = PlacementBounds(
265:         left = marginPx,
266:         top = marginPx,
267:         right = viewportWidthPx - marginPx,
268:         bottom = viewportHeightPx - marginPx,
269:     )
270:     if (viewport.width <= 0f || viewport.height <= 0f) {
271:         return null
272:     }
273: 
274:     val normalizedAnchorLeft = anchorRect.left.coerceIn(0f, viewportWidthPx)
275:     val normalizedAnchorTop = anchorRect.top.coerceIn(0f, viewportHeightPx)
276:     val normalizedAnchorRight = anchorRect.right.coerceIn(0f, viewportWidthPx)
277:     val normalizedAnchorBottom = anchorRect.bottom.coerceIn(0f, viewportHeightPx)
278: 
279:     val safeAnchorLeft = min(normalizedAnchorLeft, normalizedAnchorRight)
280:     val safeAnchorTop = min(normalizedAnchorTop, normalizedAnchorBottom)
281:     val safeAnchorRight = max(normalizedAnchorLeft, normalizedAnchorRight)
282:     val safeAnchorBottom = max(normalizedAnchorTop, normalizedAnchorBottom)
283: 
284:     val anchorCenterX = (safeAnchorLeft + safeAnchorRight) / 2f
285:     val anchorCenterY = (safeAnchorTop + safeAnchorBottom) / 2f
286:     val preferredWidth = preferredPopupWidthPx.coerceAtLeast(1f)
287:     val preferredHeight = preferredPopupHeightPx.coerceAtLeast(1f)
288: 
289:     data class CandidatePlacement(
290:         val placement: PopupPlacement,
291:         val widthRatio: Float,
292:         val heightRatio: Float,
293:         val areaRatio: Float,
294:         val priority: Int,
295:     )
296: 
297:     fun Float.clampToRange(minValue: Float, maxValue: Float): Float {
298:         return if (maxValue < minValue) minValue else coerceIn(minValue, maxValue)
299:     }
300: 
301:     fun buildCandidate(
302:         side: PopupSide,
303:         availableBounds: PlacementBounds,
304:         priority: Int,
305:     ): CandidatePlacement? {
306:         val width = min(preferredWidth, availableBounds.width)
307:         val height = min(preferredHeight, availableBounds.height)
308:         if (width <= 0f || height <= 0f) {
309:             return null
310:         }
311: 
312:         val x = when (side) {
313:             PopupSide.Right -> availableBounds.left
314:             PopupSide.Left -> availableBounds.right - width
315:             PopupSide.Above,
316:             PopupSide.Below,
317:             -> (anchorCenterX - (width / 2f)).clampToRange(availableBounds.left, availableBounds.right - width)
318:         }
319:         val y = when (side) {
320:             PopupSide.Below -> availableBounds.top
321:             PopupSide.Above -> availableBounds.bottom - height

package eu.kanade.presentation.reader

import android.graphics.RectF
import androidx.compose.foundation.clickable
import androidx.compose.foundation.interaction.MutableInteractionSource

import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxWidth

import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.size
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.width
import androidx.compose.material.icons.Icons
import androidx.compose.material.icons.outlined.Close

import androidx.compose.material3.MaterialTheme
import androidx.compose.material3.Surface
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.runtime.CompositionLocalProvider
import androidx.compose.runtime.remember
import androidx.compose.ui.Alignment
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.draw.clipToBounds
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalDensity
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.Density
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.IntOffset
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import eu.kanade.presentation.dictionary.components.DictionaryResults
import eu.kanade.tachiyomi.ui.dictionary.DictionarySearchScreenModel
import mihon.domain.dictionary.model.DictionaryTerm
import kotlin.math.max
import kotlin.math.min
import kotlin.math.roundToInt

@Composable
fun OcrResultPopup(
    onDismissRequest: () -> Unit,
    anchorRect: RectF,
    settings: OcrResultPopupSettings,
    onCopyText: () -> Unit,
    searchState: DictionarySearchScreenModel.State,
    onQueryChange: (String) -> Unit,
    onSearch: (String) -> Unit,
    onTermGroupClick: (List<DictionaryTerm>) -> Unit,
    onPlayAudioClick: (List<DictionaryTerm>) -> Unit,
    onSpeak: () -> Unit = {},
    onChooseVoice: () -> Unit = {},
    onSpeakRole: (String) -> Unit = {},
    onAddToDictionary: () -> Unit = {},
    onHidePageOverlay: (() -> Unit)? = null,
) {
    BoxWithConstraints(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
        val density = LocalDensity.current
        val marginPx = with(density) { 8.dp.toPx() }
        val gapPx = marginPx
        val viewportWidthPx = constraints.maxWidth.toFloat()
        val viewportHeightPx = constraints.maxHeight.toFloat()
        val preferredPopupWidthPx = with(density) {
            settings.widthDp.dp.toPx().coerceAtMost((viewportWidthPx - (marginPx * 2)).coerceAtLeast(1f))
        }
        val preferredPopupHeightPx = with(density) {
            settings.heightDp.dp.toPx().coerceAtMost((viewportHeightPx - (marginPx * 2)).coerceAtLeast(1f))
        }
        val contentScale = settings.contentScale.coerceAtLeast(0.1f)
        val scaledDensity =
            remember(density, contentScale) {
                Density(
                    density = density.density * contentScale,
                    fontScale = density.fontScale,
                )
            }

        val placement =
            remember(
                anchorRect,
                preferredPopupWidthPx,
                preferredPopupHeightPx,
                viewportWidthPx,
                viewportHeightPx,
                gapPx,
                marginPx,
            ) {
                calculatePopupPlacement(
                    anchorRect = anchorRect,
                    preferredPopupWidthPx = preferredPopupWidthPx,
                    preferredPopupHeightPx = preferredPopupHeightPx,
                    viewportWidthPx = viewportWidthPx,
                    viewportHeightPx = viewportHeightPx,
                    gapPx = gapPx,
                    marginPx = marginPx,
                )
            }

        if (placement == null) {
            OcrResultBottomSheet(
                onDismissRequest = onDismissRequest,
                onCopyText = onCopyText,
                searchState = searchState,
                onQueryChange = onQueryChange,
                onSearch = onSearch,
                onTermGroupClick = onTermGroupClick,
                onPlayAudioClick = onPlayAudioClick,
                // Запасной путь: всплывающее окно не поместилось, панель
                // действий всё равно нужна, иначе озвучка и словарь
                // пропадали бы именно в этом сценарии.
                actions = {
                    OcrResultActionBar(
                        onSpeak = onSpeak,
                        onSpeakRole = onSpeakRole,
                        onCopyText = onCopyText,
                        onChooseVoice = onChooseVoice,
                        onAddToDictionary = onAddToDictionary,
                        onHidePageOverlay = onHidePageOverlay,
                    )
                },
            )
        } else {
            // Тап мимо всплывающего окна закрывает результат: раньше окно
            // глотало тапы только внутри себя, а снаружи нечего было нажать.
            Box(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxSize()
                    .clickable(
                        indication = null,
                        interactionSource = remember { MutableInteractionSource() },
                        onClick = onDismissRequest,
                    ),
            )
            Surface(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .width(with(density) { placement.width.toDp() })
                    .height(with(density) { placement.height.toDp() })
                    .offset {
                        IntOffset(
                            placement.x.roundToInt(),
                            placement.y.roundToInt(),
                        )
                    }
                    .clickable(
                        indication = null,
                        interactionSource = remember { MutableInteractionSource() },
                        onClick = {},
                    ),
                shape = MaterialTheme.shapes.extraLarge,
                tonalElevation = 6.dp,
                color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface,
            ) {
                Box(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxSize()
                        .clipToBounds(),
                ) {
                    CompositionLocalProvider(
                        LocalDensity provides scaledDensity,
                    ) {
                        androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column(
                            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                        ) {
                            Row(
                                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                            ) {
                                Box(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f))
                                IconButton(
                                    onClick = onDismissRequest,
                                    modifier = Modifier.size(28.dp),
                                ) {
                                    Icon(
                                        Icons.Outlined.Close,
                                        contentDescription = "Закрыть",
                                        modifier = Modifier.size(18.dp),
                                    )
                                }
                            }

                            if (searchState.query.isNotBlank()) {
                                TranslationCard(
                                    originalText = searchState.query,
                                    modifier = Modifier.padding(8.dp),
                                )
                            }

                            DictionaryResults(
                                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize().weight(1f),
                                query = searchState.results?.query ?: "",
                                highlightRange = searchState.results?.highlightRange,
                                showQueryHeader = false,
                                isLoading = searchState.isLoading,
                                isSearching = searchState.isSearching,
                                hasSearched = searchState.hasSearched,
                                searchResults = searchState.results?.items ?: emptyList(),
                                dictionaries = searchState.dictionaries,
                                enabledDictionaryIds = searchState.enabledDictionaryIds.toSet(),
                                termMetaMap = searchState.results?.termMetaMap ?: emptyMap(),
                                existingTermExpressions = searchState.existingTermExpressions,
                                audioStates = searchState.audioStates,
                                onTermGroupClick = onTermGroupClick,
                                onPlayAudioClick = onPlayAudioClick,
                                onQueryChange = onQueryChange,
                                onSearch = onSearch,
                                onCopyText = null,
                                contentPadding = PaddingValues(8.dp),
                            )

                            HorizontalDivider()
                            OcrResultActionBar(
                                onSpeak = onSpeak,
                                onCopyText = onCopyText,
                                onChooseVoice = onChooseVoice,
                                onSpeakRole = onSpeakRole,
                                onAddToDictionary = onAddToDictionary,
                                onHidePageOverlay = onHidePageOverlay,
                                modifier = Modifier
                                    .fillMaxWidth()
                                    .padding(horizontal = 4.dp, vertical = 2.dp),
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

internal data class PopupPlacement(
    val x: Float,
    val y: Float,
    val width: Float,
    val height: Float,
)

private data class PlacementBounds(
    val left: Float,
    val top: Float,
    val right: Float,
    val bottom: Float,
) {
    val width: Float get() = (right - left).coerceAtLeast(0f)
    val height: Float get() = (bottom - top).coerceAtLeast(0f)
}

private enum class PopupSide {
    Right,
    Left,
    Below,
    Above,
}

internal fun calculatePopupPlacement(
    anchorRect: RectF,
    preferredPopupWidthPx: Float,
    preferredPopupHeightPx: Float,
    viewportWidthPx: Float,
    viewportHeightPx: Float,
    gapPx: Float,
    marginPx: Float,
): PopupPlacement? {
    val viewport = PlacementBounds(
        left = marginPx,
        top = marginPx,
        right = viewportWidthPx - marginPx,
        bottom = viewportHeightPx - marginPx,
    )
    if (viewport.width <= 0f || viewport.height <= 0f) {
        return null
    }

    val normalizedAnchorLeft = anchorRect.left.coerceIn(0f, viewportWidthPx)
    val normalizedAnchorTop = anchorRect.top.coerceIn(0f, viewportHeightPx)
    val normalizedAnchorRight = anchorRect.right.coerceIn(0f, viewportWidthPx)
    val normalizedAnchorBottom = anchorRect.bottom.coerceIn(0f, viewportHeightPx)

    val safeAnchorLeft = min(normalizedAnchorLeft, normalizedAnchorRight)
    val safeAnchorTop = min(normalizedAnchorTop, normalizedAnchorBottom)
    val safeAnchorRight = max(normalizedAnchorLeft, normalizedAnchorRight)
    val safeAnchorBottom = max(normalizedAnchorTop, normalizedAnchorBottom)

    val anchorCenterX = (safeAnchorLeft + safeAnchorRight) / 2f
    val anchorCenterY = (safeAnchorTop + safeAnchorBottom) / 2f
    val preferredWidth = preferredPopupWidthPx.coerceAtLeast(1f)
    val preferredHeight = preferredPopupHeightPx.coerceAtLeast(1f)

    data class CandidatePlacement(
        val placement: PopupPlacement,
        val widthRatio: Float,
        val heightRatio: Float,
        val areaRatio: Float,
        val priority: Int,
    )

    fun Float.clampToRange(minValue: Float, maxValue: Float): Float {
        return if (maxValue < minValue) minValue else coerceIn(minValue, maxValue)
    }

    fun buildCandidate(
        side: PopupSide,
        availableBounds: PlacementBounds,
        priority: Int,
    ): CandidatePlacement? {
        val width = min(preferredWidth, availableBounds.width)
        val height = min(preferredHeight, availableBounds.height)
        if (width <= 0f || height <= 0f) {
            return null
        }

        val x = when (side) {
            PopupSide.Right -> availableBounds.left
            PopupSide.Left -> availableBounds.right - width
            PopupSide.Above,
            PopupSide.Below,
            -> (anchorCenterX - (width / 2f)).clampToRange(availableBounds.left, availableBounds.right - width)
        }
        val y = when (side) {
            PopupSide.Below -> availableBounds.top
            PopupSide.Above -> availableBounds.bottom - height
            PopupSide.Right,
            PopupSide.Left,
            -> (anchorCenterY - (height / 2f)).clampToRange(availableBounds.top, availableBounds.bottom - height)
        }

        val placement = PopupPlacement(
            x = x,
            y = y,
            width = width,
            height = height,
        )

        return CandidatePlacement(
            placement = placement,
            widthRatio = width / preferredWidth,
            heightRatio = height / preferredHeight,
            areaRatio = (width * height) / (preferredWidth * preferredHeight),
            priority = priority,
        )
    }

    val candidateSpecs = listOf(
        Triple(
            PopupSide.Right,
            PlacementBounds(
                left = max(safeAnchorRight + gapPx, viewport.left),
                top = viewport.top,
                right = viewport.right,
                bottom = viewport.bottom,
            ),
            0,
        ),
        Triple(
            PopupSide.Left,
            PlacementBounds(
                left = viewport.left,
                top = viewport.top,
                right = min(safeAnchorLeft - gapPx, viewport.right),
                bottom = viewport.bottom,
            ),
            1,
        ),
        Triple(
            PopupSide.Below,
            PlacementBounds(
                left = viewport.left,
                top = max(safeAnchorBottom + gapPx, viewport.top),
                right = viewport.right,
                bottom = viewport.bottom,
            ),
            2,
        ),
        Triple(
            PopupSide.Above,
            PlacementBounds(
                left = viewport.left,
                top = viewport.top,
                right = viewport.right,
                bottom = min(safeAnchorTop - gapPx, viewport.bottom),
            ),
            3,
        ),
    )

    val bestCandidate =
        candidateSpecs
            .mapNotNull { (side, bounds, priority) -> buildCandidate(side, bounds, priority) }
            .sortedWith(
                compareByDescending<CandidatePlacement> { it.areaRatio }
                    .thenByDescending { min(it.widthRatio, it.heightRatio) }
                    .thenByDescending { it.widthRatio >= 1f && it.heightRatio >= 1f }
                    .thenBy { it.priority },
            )
            .firstOrNull()
            ?: return null

    val minimumWidthRatio = 0.55f
    val minimumHeightRatio = 0.40f
    val minimumAreaRatio = 0.35f
    val isUsableFloatingPopup =
        bestCandidate.widthRatio >= minimumWidthRatio &&
            bestCandidate.heightRatio >= minimumHeightRatio &&
            bestCandidate.areaRatio >= minimumAreaRatio

    return if (isUsableFloatingPopup) {
        bestCandidate.placement
    } else {
        null
    }
}

import tachiyomi.i18n.MR
import tachiyomi.presentation.core.components.ResizableSheet
import tachiyomi.presentation.core.components.SheetValue
import tachiyomi.presentation.core.components.material.padding

private const val SHEET_EXPANSION_THRESHOLD = 0.80f

@Composable
fun OcrResultBottomSheet(
    onDismissRequest: () -> Unit,
    onCopyText: () -> Unit,
    searchState: DictionarySearchScreenModel.State,
    onQueryChange: (String) -> Unit,
    onSearch: (String) -> Unit,
    onTermGroupClick: (List<DictionaryTerm>) -> Unit,
    onPlayAudioClick: (List<DictionaryTerm>) -> Unit,
    actions: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null,
) {
    // Use BoxWithConstraints to measure the actual available space for the sheet content
    BoxWithConstraints(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
        contentAlignment = Alignment.BottomCenter,
    ) {
        val useSideSheet = maxWidth >= 600.dp

        ResizableSheet(
            onDismissRequest = onDismissRequest,

310:     /** Прямоугольник зафиксированной области в пикселях экрана. */
311:     private fun fixedRegionRect(): Rect? {
312:         val region = parseRegion() ?: return null
313:         val dm = resources.displayMetrics
314:         return Rect(
315:             (region.l * dm.widthPixels).toInt(),
316:             (region.t * dm.heightPixels).toInt(),
317:             (region.r * dm.widthPixels).toInt(),
318:             (region.b * dm.heightPixels).toInt(),
319:         ).takeIf { it.width() > 0 && it.height() > 0 }
320:     }

322:     /**
323:      * Включает режим чтения.
324:      *
325:      * Захват экрана разрешается системным диалогом, поэтому его нельзя
326:      * начать из фонового сервиса молча: вызывающий обязан получить
327:      * [MediaProjection] из [MediaProjectionManager.getMediaProjection].
328:      */
329:     fun startReading(projection: android.media.projection.MediaProjection) {
330:         val rect = fixedRegionRect()
331:         if (rect == null) {
332:             toast("Сначала задайте область рамки")
333:             return
334:         }
335:         if (!OverlayGestureService.isEnabled()) {
336:             // Не листаем молча: цикл чтения без Службы доступности провисит,
337:             // дожидаясь её включения, и читатель не понимает, чего не хватает.
338:             toast("Без Службы доступности листать нечем — включаю настройки")
339:             requestGestureService()
340:         }
341:         stopReading()
342:         readProjection = projection
343:         val engine = OverlayCaptureEngine(applicationContext, projection)
344:         capture = engine
345:         val reader = OverlayAutoReader(applicationContext, engine)
346:         autoReader = reader
347:         readJob = reader.start(
348:             scope = serviceScope,
349:             region = rect,
350:             onPage = { text -> uiHandler.post { setBubble(text) } },
351:             onNote = { note ->
352:                 uiHandler.post {
353:                     setBubble(note)
354:                     readingState.value = isReading
355:                 }
356:             },
357:         )
358:         readingState.value = true
359:         toast("Чтение: ${reader.engineTitle()}")
360:     }

362:     fun stopReading() {
363:         readJob?.cancel()
364:         readJob = null
365:         runCatching { capture?.stop() }
366:         capture = null
367:         runCatching { readProjection?.stop() }
368:         readProjection = null
369:         autoReader = null
370:         readingState.value = false
371:         runCatching { readEngine.stop() }
372:     }

391:     override fun onStartCommand(intent: Intent?, flags: Int, startId: Int): Int {
392:         if (!canDrawOverlays(this)) {
393:             stopSelf()
394:             return START_NOT_STICKY
395:         }
396:         ensureForeground()
397:         if (root == null) buildOverlay()
398:         when (intent?.action) {
399:             ACTION_SPEAK -> {
400:                 val text = intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_TEXT).orEmpty()
401:                 if (text.isNotBlank()) {
402:                     expandNow()
403:                     speakText(text)
404:                 }
405:             }
406:             ACTION_STT_START -> toggleStt(force = true)
407:             ACTION_STT_STOP -> toggleStt(force = false)
408:             ACTION_SELECT_REGION -> {
409:                 expandNow()
410:                 openSelector()
411:             }
412:             ACTION_REFRESH -> {
413:                 applyClipboardWatch()
414:                 applyFrame()
415:             }
416:             ACTION_START_READING -> {
417:                 val code = intent.getIntExtra(EXTRA_RESULT_CODE, 0)
418:                 val data: Intent? = intent.getParcelableExtra(EXTRA_RESULT_DATA)
419:                 if (data == null) {
420:                     toast("Разрешение на захват не получено")
421:                 } else {
422:                     val projection = runCatching {
423:                         val mpm = getSystemService(Context.MEDIA_PROJECTION_SERVICE)
424:                             as android.media.projection.MediaProjectionManager
425:                         mpm.getMediaProjection(code, data)
426:                     }.getOrNull()
427:                     if (projection == null) {
428:                         toast("Не удалось начать захват экрана")
429:                     } else {
430:                         startReading(projection)
431:                     }
432:                 }
433:             }
434:         }
435:         applyClipboardWatch()
436:         applyFrame()
437:         // Панель не должна висеть поверх наших собственных настроек и
438:         // читалки: иначе полупрозрачная панель лежала на экране поверх текста.
439:         updatePanelVisibility()
440:         return START_STICKY
441:     }

466:         setWindowFocusable(true)

474:     /**
475:      * Прячет панель, пока на экране само приложение.
476:      *
477:      * Сверху окна с разрешением SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW нельзя спрятать наше
478:      * собственное окно, но можно не рисовать панель поверх него: иначе
479:      * настройки оверлея открывались поверх самих себя.
480:      *
481:      * Раньше «мы на переднем плане» определялось через UsageStatsManager, и
482:      * без разрешения «usage access» (оно в приложение не запрашивается)
483:      * проверка всегда возвращала false — панель так и висела поверх наших
484:      * же настроек. Теперь это обычные колбэки жизненного цикла Activity:
485:      * ничего разрешать не нужно и ошибки быть не может.
486:      */
487:     private var ownActivitiesResumed = 0
488: 
489:     private val ownActivityWatcher = object : Application.ActivityLifecycleCallbacks {
490:         override fun onActivityResumed(activity: Activity) {
491:             if (activity.packageName != packageName) return
492:             ownActivitiesResumed++
493:             updatePanelVisibility()
494:         }
495: 
496:         override fun onActivityPaused(activity: Activity) {
497:             if (activity.packageName != packageName) return
498:             ownActivitiesResumed = (ownActivitiesResumed - 1).coerceAtLeast(0)
499:             updatePanelVisibility()
500:         }
501: 
502:         override fun onActivityCreated(activity: Activity, savedInstanceState: Bundle?) = Unit
503:         override fun onActivityStarted(activity: Activity) = Unit
504:         override fun onActivityStopped(activity: Activity) = Unit
505:         override fun onActivitySaveInstanceState(activity: Activity, outState: Bundle) = Unit
506:         override fun onActivityDestroyed(activity: Activity) = Unit
507:     }

509:     private fun updatePanelVisibility() {
510:         val view = root ?: return
511:         val wanted = if (ownActivitiesResumed > 0) View.GONE else View.VISIBLE
512:         if (view.visibility != wanted) view.visibility = wanted
513:     }

516:     private fun ensureForeground() {
517:         val nm = getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE) as NotificationManager
518:         if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
519:             nm.createNotificationChannel(
520:                 NotificationChannel(CHANNEL_ID, "OCR-оверлей", NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_LOW),
521:             )
522:         }
523:         val launch = packageManager.getLaunchIntentForPackage(packageName)
524:         val contentIntent = launch?.let {
525:             PendingIntent.getActivity(
526:                 this,
527:                 0,
528:                 it,
529:                 PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE or PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT,
530:             )
531:         }
532:         val builder = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
533:             Notification.Builder(this, CHANNEL_ID)
534:         } else {
535:             @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
536:             Notification.Builder(this)
537:         }
538:         val b = builder

747:     /** Полноэкранный селектор: потяните пальцем прямоугольник области. */
748:     private fun openSelector() {
749:         if (selectorRoot != null) return
750:         val dm = resources.displayMetrics
751:         val layout = FrameLayout(this)
752:         layout.setBackgroundColor(0x88000000.toInt())
753:         val draw = RegionDrawView(this)
754:         layout.addView(draw, FrameLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT))
755:         selectorDraw = draw
756: 
757:         val hint = TextView(this)
758:         hint.text = "Выделите область пальцем • тап — отмена"
759:         hint.setTextColor(0xFFFFFFFF.toInt())
760:         hint.textSize = 14f
761:         hint.gravity = Gravity.CENTER
762:         hint.setPadding(0, dp(48f), 0, 0)
763:         layout.addView(hint, FrameLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, Gravity.TOP))
764: 
765:         var downX = 0f
766:         var downY = 0f
767:         var moved = false
768:         layout.setOnTouchListener { _, event ->
769:             when (event.actionMasked) {
770:                 MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN -> {
771:                     downX = event.rawX
772:                     downY = event.rawY
773:                     moved = false
774:                     draw.setRect(downX, downY, downX, downY)
775:                     true
776:                 }
777:                 MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE -> {
778:                     moved = true
779:                     draw.setRect(downX, downY, event.rawX, event.rawY)
780:                     true
781:                 }
782:                 MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL -> {
783:                     if (!moved) {
784:                         closeSelector()
785:                     } else {
786:                         val r = draw.normalized(dm.widthPixels, dm.heightPixels)
787:                         if (r != null) {
788:                             prefs.overlayFixedRegion().set("${r.l},${r.t},${r.r},${r.b}")
789:                             prefs.overlayRegionMode().set("fixed")
790:                             updateRegionButton()
791:                             toast("Область зафиксирована")
792:                         }
793:                         closeSelector()
794:                         applyFrame()
795:                     }
796:                     true
797:                 }
798:                 else -> false
799:             }
800:         }
801: 
802:         val windowType = overlayType()
803:         val p = WindowManager.LayoutParams(
804:             ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
805:             ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
806:             windowType,
807:             WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_FOCUSABLE or
808:                 WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_LAYOUT_IN_SCREEN,
809:             PixelFormat.TRANSLUCENT,
810:         )
811:         selectorRoot = layout
812:         runCatching { wm.addView(layout, p) }.onFailure {
813:             selectorRoot = null
814:             toast("Не удалось открыть выбор области")
815:         }
816:     }

824:     /** Рамка зафиксированной области: тонкие границы, клики — сквозь. */
825:     private fun applyFrame() {
826:         val show = prefs.overlayShowFrame().get() &&
827:             prefs.overlayRegionMode().get() == "fixed" &&
828:             parseRegion() != null
829:         frameVisibleState.value = show
830:         if (!show) {
831:             frameRoot?.let { runCatching { wm.removeView(it) } }
832:             frameRoot = null
833:             frameParams = null
834:             return
835:         }
836:         val region = parseRegion() ?: return
837:         val dm = resources.displayMetrics
838:         val x = (region.l * dm.widthPixels).toInt()
839:         val y = (region.t * dm.heightPixels).toInt()
840:         val w = ((region.r - region.l) * dm.widthPixels).toInt().coerceAtLeast(dp(24f))
841:         val h = ((region.b - region.t) * dm.heightPixels).toInt().coerceAtLeast(dp(24f))
842:         val thickness = dp(3f)
843:         val color = 0xFF4A7EAF.toInt()
844: 
845:         val box = FrameLayout(this)
846:         fun border(wPx: Int, hPx: Int, gravity: Int): View {
847:             val v = View(this)
848:             v.setBackgroundColor(color)
849:             box.addView(v, FrameLayout.LayoutParams(wPx, hPx, gravity))
850:             return v
851:         }
852:         border(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, thickness, Gravity.TOP)
853:         border(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, thickness, Gravity.BOTTOM)
854:         border(thickness, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, Gravity.START)
855:         border(thickness, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, Gravity.END)
856: 
857:         val existing = frameRoot
858:         if (existing != null && frameParams != null) {
859:             frameParams!!.x = x
860:             frameParams!!.y = y
861:             frameParams!!.width = w
862:             frameParams!!.height = h
863:             frameRoot = box
864:             runCatching {
865:                 wm.removeView(existing)
866:                 wm.addView(box, frameParams!!)
867:             }.onFailure {
868:                 frameRoot = null
869:                 frameParams = null
870:             }
871:             return
872:         }
873:         val p = WindowManager.LayoutParams(
874:             w,
875:             h,
876:             overlayType(),
877:             WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_FOCUSABLE or
878:                 WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_TOUCHABLE or
879:                 WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_LAYOUT_IN_SCREEN,
880:             PixelFormat.TRANSLUCENT,
881:         )
882:         p.gravity = Gravity.TOP or Gravity.START
883:         p.x = x
884:         p.y = y
885:         frameRoot = box
886:         frameParams = p
887:         runCatching { wm.addView(box, p) }.onFailure {
888:             frameRoot = null
889:             frameParams = null
890:         }
891:     }

960:     /**
961:      * Панель оверлея.
962:      *
963:      * Свёрнута — круглая кнопка у края экрана, как в читалке. Раскрыта —
964:      * карточка пунктов над кнопкой; последняя строка убирает меню в кнопку
965:      * («скрыть») и выключает оверлей («закрыть»).

967:     @Composable
968:     private fun OverlayPanel() {
969:         val expanded = menuExpanded.value
970:         Column(
971:             modifier = Modifier
972:                 .fillMaxSize()
973:                 // Свёрнутая панель — это ровно кнопка 56dp в окне 60dp, любой
974:                 // дополнительный отступ её бы обрезал.
975:                 .padding(if (expanded) PANEL_PADDING_DP.dp else 0.dp),
976:             verticalArrangement = if (expanded) Arrangement.Bottom else Arrangement.Center,
977:             horizontalAlignment = Alignment.End,
978:         ) {
979:             if (expanded) {
980:                 OcrControlMenuCard(
981:                     rows = menuRows(),
982:                     // Ширину окна держим фиксированной, а по высоте следим за
983:                     // содержимым: иначе карточка измеряется по ширине кнопки и
984:                     // высота неизвестна заранее.
985:                     modifier = Modifier.onSizeChanged { onPanelMeasured(it.height) },
986:                     maxHeight = maxPanelCardHeight().dp,
987:                     status = panelStatus(),
988:                     footer = "yomikai " + eu.kanade.tachiyomi.AppInfo.getVersionName(),
989:                     extraContent = { panelInput() },
990:                 )
991:                 Spacer(Modifier.height(PANEL_GAP_DP.dp))
992:             }
993:             OcrControlFab(
994:                 expanded = expanded,
995:                 onToggle = { if (expanded) collapseNow() else expandNow() },
996:                 onDrag = ::dragPanelBy,
997:                 onDragEnd = ::settlePanel,
998:                 contentDescription = if (expanded) "Скрыть меню оверлея" else "Меню оверлея",
999:             )
1000:         }

1003:     /** Высота окна с раскрытой панелью, px. */
1004:     private fun maxWindowHeightPx(): Int =
1005:         (resources.displayMetrics.heightPixels * MAX_PANEL_SCREEN_FRACTION).toInt()
1006: 
1007:     /** Высота, доступная карточке: из окна вычитаем кнопку и отступы, dp. */
1008:     private fun maxPanelCardHeight(): Int {
1009:         val overheadPx = dp(BTN_DP) + dp(PANEL_GAP_DP) + dp(PANEL_PADDING_DP) * 2
1010:         val availablePx = (maxWindowHeightPx() - overheadPx).coerceAtLeast(dp(120f))
1011:         // Делить на настоящую плотность экрана: dp(1f) округляется до целого и
1012:         // на экране с density 2.75 дало бы завышенный лимит высоты.
1013:         return (availablePx / resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()
1014:     }

1016:     /**
1017:      * Высота окна следует за высотой карточки.
1018:      *
1019:      * Раньше окно было фиксированной высоты 340dp без прокрутки, и нижние
1020:      * пункты меню вместе с полем ввода просто обрезались.
1021:      */
1022:     private fun onPanelMeasured(cardHeightPx: Int) {
1023:         val lp = params ?: return
1024:         if (!menuExpanded.value || cardHeightPx <= 0) return
1025:         val wanted = (cardHeightPx + dp(BTN_DP) + dp(PANEL_GAP_DP) + dp(PANEL_PADDING_DP) * 2)
1026:             .coerceAtMost(maxWindowHeightPx())
1027:         // Запоминаем: после сворачивания окно должно вернуться к этой же
1028:         // высоте, а не прыгать на 340dp, пока карточка не измерится заново.
1029:         expandedH = wanted
1030:         if (lp.height == wanted) return
1031:         lp.height = wanted
1032:         clampToScreen(lp)
1033:         runCatching { root?.let { wm.updateViewLayout(it, lp) } }
1034:     }

8: import android.hardware.display.VirtualDisplay
9: import android.media.ImageReader
10: import android.os.Handler
11: import android.os.HandlerThread
12: import android.util.DisplayMetrics
13: import android.util.Log
14: import android.view.WindowManager
15: 
16: /**
17:  * Захват экрана через MediaProjection и вырезание рамки.
18:  *
19:  * Перенесено из отдельного приложения overlay-reader в основной Yomikai:
20:  * режим «рамка поверх окна» должен работать без установки второй программы.
21:  *
22:  * VirtualDisplay создаётся один раз и держится до остановки — это
23:  * единственный надёжный путь на Android 14+, где пересоздание дисплеев
24:  * одноразовыми проекциями запрещено.
25:  */
26: class OverlayCaptureEngine(
27:     context: Context,
28:     private val projection: android.media.projection.MediaProjection,
29: ) {
30:     private val appContext = context.applicationContext
31: 
32:     private var thread: HandlerThread? = null
33:     private var handler: Handler? = null
34:     private var reader: ImageReader? = null
35:     private var display: VirtualDisplay? = null
36:     private var sizeW: Int = 0
37:     private var sizeH: Int = 0
38:     private var density: Int = 0
39: 
40:     /** Размер захватываемого экрана в px (актуальны после первого capture). */
41:     var screenWidth: Int = 0
42:         private set
43:     var screenHeight: Int = 0
44:         private set
45: 
46:     /** Захватить текущий кадр и вернуть битмап области [rect] (в экранных px). */
47:     fun capture(rect: Rect): Bitmap? {
48:         if (display == null && !ensureStarted()) return null
49: 
50:         // Статичный экран может долго не порождать новых кадров (AUTO_MIRROR
51:         // отрисовывает только «грязные» области) — крутимся до 3 секунд.
52:         val succeedAt = System.currentTimeMillis() + 3000
53:         var image: android.media.Image? = null
54:         while (image == null && System.currentTimeMillis() < succeedAt) {
55:             image = reader?.acquireLatestImage()
56:             if (image == null) Thread.sleep(120)
57:         }
58:         val img = image ?: return null
59:         return try {
60:             val full = copyImage(img) ?: return null
61:             try {
62:                 val left = rect.left.coerceIn(0, full.width - 1)
63:                 val top = rect.top.coerceIn(0, full.height - 1)
64:                 val right = rect.right.coerceIn(left + 1, full.width)
65:                 val bottom = rect.bottom.coerceIn(top + 1, full.height)
66:                 Bitmap.createBitmap(full, left, top, right - left, bottom - top)
67:             } finally {
68:                 if (!full.isRecycled) full.recycle()
69:             }
70:         } finally {
71:             img.close()
72:         }
73:     }
74: 
75:     private fun ensureStarted(): Boolean {
76:         if (display != null && reader != null) return true
77:         // Предыдущая попытка могла упасть уже после создания ImageReader:
78:         // тогда reader остался не-null, а display — null, и ensureStarted()
79:         // больше никогда не доходил до createVirtualDisplay (захват умирал
80:         // навсегда). Перед повтором разбираем half-initialized состояние.
81:         releaseCaptureResources()
82: 
83:         val metrics = DisplayMetrics()
84:         @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
85:         (appContext.getSystemService(Context.WINDOW_SERVICE) as WindowManager)
86:             .defaultDisplay
87:             .getRealMetrics(metrics)
88:         sizeW = metrics.widthPixels
89:         sizeH = metrics.heightPixels
90:         density = metrics.densityDpi
91:         screenWidth = sizeW
92:         screenHeight = sizeH
93:         if (sizeW <= 0 || sizeH <= 0) return false
94: 
95:         thread = HandlerThread("overlay_capture").also { it.start() }
96:         handler = Handler(thread!!.looper)
97:         reader = ImageReader.newInstance(sizeW, sizeH, PixelFormat.RGBA_8888, 2)
98:         display = try {
99:             projection.createVirtualDisplay(
100:                 "yomikai_overlay_capture",
101:                 sizeW,
102:                 sizeH,
103:                 density,
104:                 DisplayManager.VIRTUAL_DISPLAY_FLAG_AUTO_MIRROR,
105:                 reader!!.surface,
106:                 null,
107:                 handler,
108:             )
109:         } catch (e: Exception) {
110:             Log.e("YomikaiOverlayCapture", "createVirtualDisplay failed", e)
111:             null
112:         }
113:         if (display == null) {
114:             // Чистим за собой, чтобы следующий capture() честно попробовал снова.
115:             releaseCaptureResources()
116:         }
117:         return display != null
118:     }
119: 
120:     /**
121:      * Гасит только собственные ресурсы захвата. MediaProjection не трогаем:
122:      * она принадлежит сервису, и её остановка погасила бы всю сессию.
123:      */
124:     private fun releaseCaptureResources() {
125:         runCatching { display?.release() }
126:         runCatching { reader?.close() }
127:         display = null
128:         reader = null
129:         handler?.looper?.quitSafely()
130:         thread?.join(500)
131:         thread = null
132:         handler = null
133:     }
134: 
135:     private fun copyImage(image: android.media.Image): Bitmap? {
136:         val plane = image.planes[0]
137:         val buffer = plane.buffer
138:         val pixelStride = plane.pixelStride
139:         val rowStride = plane.rowStride
140:         val rowPadding = rowStride - pixelStride * image.width
141:         if (rowPadding < 0) return null
142: 
143:         val aux = Bitmap.createBitmap(
144:             image.width + rowPadding / pixelStride,
145:             image.height,
146:             Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888,
147:         )
148:         aux.copyPixelsFromBuffer(buffer)
149:         val bmp = Bitmap.createBitmap(aux, 0, 0, image.width, image.height)
150:         if (!aux.isRecycled) aux.recycle()
151:         return bmp
152:     }
153: 
154:     fun stop() {
155:         releaseCaptureResources()
156:         runCatching { projection.stop() }
157:     }
158: }

(End of file - total 158 lines)

parts.text:
Now let me carefully audit the OverlayView.kt for critical bugs in the working tree state.

### OverlayView.kt analysis

1. **`layoutPanel()` uses `statusPaint.textSize` which is in px; fine.** `collapsed = min(statusPaint.textSize * 2.2f, viewH * 0.09f)`. With density 3 and sp 11 → textSize = 11*3 = 33px; *2.2 = 72.6px. viewH*0.09 for 2400px screen = 216. So collapsed = 72.6px ≈ 24dp. OK.

   `expanded = min(dp(132f), viewH * 0.30f)`. dp(132) at density 3 = 396. viewH*0.3 for 2400 = 720. So expanded = 396px = 132dp. OK.

   Now the key issue: `layoutPanel()` uses `viewH` and `viewW`, but it's called from the `resultText` setter. `resultText` is a public property set by the service (on the main thread). `viewW/viewH` are only set in `layoutMetrics`, called from `onSizeChanged`. That's fine.

   **CRITICAL: `resultText` setter calls `clampFrame()`, which reads `frame` — a `lateinit var`.** If the service sets `resultText` before `onSizeChanged` has run (i.e., before layout), `frame` is not initialized → `UninitializedPropertyAccessException`. Is that possible? `addOverlayWindow(view)` then `wm.addView(view, lp)` → layout happens async. `startReader` sets overlay = overlayView right after addView. `scan()` is triggered by user touch which happens after layout. So in practice probably not. But wait — `layoutPanel()` also guards `if (viewH <= 0f) return`, but `clampFrame()` guards `if (viewW <= 0f || viewH <= 0f) return`. Both guard on viewW/viewH being 0, which are only set in layoutMetrics, which sets them BEFORE `frame = RectF(...)`. So actually if viewW<=0 returns early. So the lateinit access is guarded. Hmm, unless layoutMetrics set viewW and then something throws... Actually `layoutMetrics` sets `viewW = w; viewH = h` at lines 167-168, then `toolbarRect`, then `layoutPanel()`, then reads Prefs and creates `frame`. So if `Prefs.frame()` throws (e.g., Prefs not initialized → `UninitializedPropertyAccessException` on `sp`), then viewW/viewH are set but `frame` remains uninitialized, and a later `clampFrame()` would crash. Prefs.init is called in service onCreate, before view creation. So low risk. But it's still a fragile lateinit. Medium.

   Actually WAIT. There is a much more concrete problem: `onSizeChanged` is called with w=0,h=0 in some cases? Actually no, for MATCH_PARENT WindowManager overlay, size will be the screen size.

2. **`onDraw` — the dim rectangles math.** Let's check: The new code draws:
   - (0,0,viewW,toolbarRect.bottom)
   - (0, toolbarRect.bottom, frame.left, frame.top)
   - (frame.right, toolbarRect.bottom, viewW, frame.top)
   - (0, frame.top, frame.left, frame.bottom)
   - (frame.right, frame.top, viewW, frame.bottom)
   - (0, frame.bottom, viewW, viewH)

   That's correct-ish: it covers top band, left band, right band, bottom band. But it MISSES the region below the panel: `(0, panelRect.top, viewW, viewH)` if panelRect.top > frame.bottom. Well, frame.bottom <= panelRect.top - padT, so the 6th rect (0, frame.bottom, viewW, viewH) covers it including panel area. Good.

   Hmm but what if `frame.top < toolbarRect.bottom`? clampFrame ensures frame.top >= toolbarRect.bottom + padT. But `layoutMetrics` calls `clampFrame()` after setting frame — and clampFrame requires toolbarRect and panelRect to be set. They are. Good.

   BUT: `drawRect` with inverted rect (left > right) — Canvas.drawRect with l > r: Skia handles it (it just draws nothing or draws reversed?). Actually Android's `Canvas.drawRect(float,float,float,float,Paint)` doesn't throw for l>r; Skia will draw a rect with negative width which typically renders nothing. So no crash.

25:         fun onReady(ready: Boolean)
26:     }

28:     private var tts: TextToSpeech? = null
29:     private var voices: List<android.speech.tts.Voice> = emptyList()
30:     private var ready = false
31: 
32:     fun init(callback: ReadyCallback?) {

35:             if (status == TextToSpeech.SUCCESS) {

39:                     ?.ifEmpty { tts?.voices?.toList() }
40:                     ?: emptyList()
41:                 applyVoiceIndex(Prefs.ttsVoiceIndex())
42:             }

45:     }
46: 
47:     val isReady: Boolean get() = ready && tts != null
48: 
49:     fun availableVoiceCount(): Int = voices.size
50: 
51:     fun cycleVoice(): Int {

53:         val current = Prefs.ttsVoiceIndex()
54:         val next = (current + 1) % voices.size
55:         Prefs.setTtsVoiceIndex(next)
56:         applyVoiceIndex(next)

58:     }

45:     private fun prepareImage(image: Bitmap): PreparedImage {
46:         val maxDim = maxOf(image.width, image.height)
47:         val scaled = if (maxDim > MAX_IMAGE_DIMENSION) {
48:             val factor = MAX_IMAGE_DIMENSION.toFloat() / maxDim.toFloat()
49:             Bitmap.createScaledBitmap(
50:                 image,
51:                 (image.width * factor).toInt().coerceAtLeast(1),
52:                 (image.height * factor).toInt().coerceAtLeast(1),
53:                 true,
54:             )
55:         } else {
56:             null
57:         }
58:         val working = scaled ?: image
59:         return try {
60:             val out = ByteArrayOutputStream()
61:             working.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, 85, out)
62:             if (out.size() == 0) throw IOException("Failed to encode image for GLens request")

135:     private fun parseResponse(bytes: ByteArray): OcrResult {
136:         val reader = ProtoReader(bytes)
137:         val lines = mutableListOf<ParsedLine>()
138:         while (reader.hasRemaining()) {
139:             val tag = reader.readTag()
140:             if (tag == 0) break
141:             val field = tag ushr 3
142:             val wire = tag and WIRE_MASK
143:             if (field == SERVER_RESPONSE_OBJECTS_RESPONSE && wire == WIRE_LEN) {
144:                 lines += parseObjectsResponse(reader.readBytes())
145:             } else {
